Name: Amariah, Son of Hebron
Summary: Second son of Hebron in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:19; 1 Chronicles 24:23: Second son of Hebron in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Amariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
